title: Mia and the Red Kite
summary: Mia follows her kite after the wind carries it away.

sentences.text: Mia has a bright red kite.
sentences.chineseHint: 米娅有一只鲜红色的风筝。

sentences.text: She runs with it under the blue sky.
sentences.chineseHint: 她在蓝天下带着风筝奔跑。

sentences.text: A strong wind lifts the kite above a green tree.
sentences.chineseHint: 一阵大风把风筝吹到一棵绿树上方。

sentences.text: The red kite lands in the tree.
sentences.chineseHint: 红风筝落在了树上。

sentences.text: Mia asks her tall brother Ben for help.
sentences.chineseHint: 米娅请高个子的哥哥本来帮忙。

sentences.text: Ben reaches the string, and they fly the kite together.
sentences.chineseHint: 本够到了线，他们一起放风筝。

vocabulary.definition: full of strong light or color
a light toy that flies in the wind

vocabulary.example: The kite lands in a tree.

title: Ben's Tiny Garden
summary: Ben learns how a seed becomes a flower.

sentences.text: Ben puts a small seed in a brown pot.
sentences.chineseHint: 本把一颗小种子放进棕色花盆。

sentences.text: He gives it water every morning.
sentences.chineseHint: 他每天早上给它浇水。

sentences.text: The warm sun shines on the pot.
sentences.chineseHint: 温暖的阳光照在花盆上。

sentences.text: First, a green leaf appears.
sentences.chineseHint: 首先，一片绿叶出现了。

sentences.text: Next, the stem grows tall.
sentences.chineseHint: 接着，茎长高了。

sentences.text: At last, a yellow flower opens, and Ben smiles.
sentences.chineseHint: 最后，一朵黄花开放了，本笑了。

vocabulary.definition: the small beginning of a plant

vocabulary.example: The plant is in a pot.

vocabulary.definition: a flat green part of a plant
the main upright part of a plant

questions.prompt: What does Ben put in the pot?

title: The Sleepy Little Train
summary: A little train finishes its evening trip.

sentences.text: A little train wakes at six o'clock.
sentences.chineseHint: 一列小火车六点醒来。

sentences.text: It carries people past farms and rivers.
sentences.chineseHint: 它载着人们经过农场和河流。

sentences.text: At noon, it rests beside the station clock.
sentences.chineseHint: 中午，它在车站钟旁休息。

sentences.text: At seven in the evening, the last family gets off.
sentences.chineseHint: 晚上七点，最后一家人下车。

sentences.text: The little train rolls into its warm shed.
sentences.chineseHint: 小火车驶进温暖的车棚。

sentences.text: It closes its lights and sleeps until morning.
sentences.chineseHint: 它关上灯，睡到早晨。

vocabulary.example: The train stops at the station.

vocabulary.definition: the end part of the day
vocabulary.example: It is seven in the evening.
The train sleeps in a shed.

questions.prompt: What time does the train wake?
Where does it rest at noon?

title: Coco Finds a Friend
summary: A shy puppy learns to introduce herself.

sentences.text: Coco is a shy brown puppy at the park.
sentences.chineseHint: 可可是一只在公园里的害羞棕色小狗。

sentences.text: She sees a white rabbit playing with a ball.
sentences.chineseHint: 她看见一只白兔在玩球。

sentences.text: Coco feels nervous, but she walks closer.
sentences.chineseHint: 可可感到紧张，但她走近了一些。

sentences.text: Hello, my name is Coco, she says.
sentences.chineseHint: “你好，我叫可可，”她说。

sentences.text: I am Pip, says the rabbit with a smile.
sentences.chineseHint: “我是皮普，”兔子笑着说。

sentences.text: Soon Coco and Pip feel happy as they roll the ball together.
sentences.chineseHint: 很快，可可和皮普一起滚球，感到很开心。

vocabulary.definition: a small animal with long ears

questions.prompt: How do the friends feel at the end?

title: A Picnic for Five
summary: Five friends count and share picnic food.

sentences.text: Five friends meet beside the lake for a picnic.
sentences.chineseHint: 五个朋友在湖边野餐。

sentences.text: Ana brings five apples, and Tom brings ten small sandwiches.
sentences.chineseHint: 安娜带来五个苹果，汤姆带来十个小三明治。

sentences.text: Mei pours five cups of orange juice.
sentences.chineseHint: 梅倒了五杯橙汁。

sentences.text: Each friend gets one apple, two sandwiches, and one cup.
sentences.chineseHint: 每个朋友得到一个苹果、两个三明治和一杯果汁。

sentences.text: They save the crumbs for the ducks, not their plastic bags.
sentences.chineseHint: 他们把面包屑留给鸭子，但不留下塑料袋。

sentences.text: The five friends clean the grass before they go home.
sentences.chineseHint: 五个朋友回家前清理了草地。

vocabulary.definition: makes a drink flow into a cup

questions.prompt: How many friends have the picnic?
What do they clean before leaving?

title: The Moon in My Window
summary: Lina watches the moon change as clouds pass.

sentences.text: Lina sees a round moon in her window at night.
sentences.chineseHint: 夜里，莉娜从窗户看到一轮圆月。

sentences.text: A gray cloud covers half of it.
sentences.chineseHint: 一朵灰云遮住了月亮的一半。

sentences.text: Lina thinks the moon is playing hide-and-seek.
sentences.chineseHint: 莉娜觉得月亮在玩捉迷藏。

sentences.text: The cloud moves, and silver light fills her room.
sentences.chineseHint: 云移开了，银色月光充满房间。

sentences.text: Lina draws the moon and three bright stars.
sentences.chineseHint: 莉娜画下月亮和三颗明亮的星星。

sentences.text: She puts the picture near her bed and says good night.
sentences.chineseHint: 她把画放在床边，然后说晚安。

vocabulary.definition: the bright object seen in the night sky
a white or gray shape in the sky
makes a picture with a pen or pencil

questions.prompt: When does Lina see the moon?
Where does Lina put her picture?
